Type: round sunburst wood wall mirror
Use: decorating a wall, reflecting light; living room, bedroom, entryway, on a wall
Style: coastal, farmhouse, bohemian
Materials: distressed whitewashed wood slats, mirror glass
Colors: distressed white, light brown wood showing through
Shape: large round, radiating slat frame around small round mirror, wide and flat
Feel: breezy, relaxed, bright
Goes with: white, sand, light blue, rattan; coastal or cottage rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Driftwood Mirror, 36" H, Distressed White
product.description: Sun-bleached driftwood is the inspiration for this mirror. Precision-cut pieces of wood come together to create a rustic-style frame, finished in a subtle whitewash for a lightly distressed effect. It arrives ready to hang, all hardware included. 1.5"D x 36"W x 36"H Natural and engineered woods, glass Use glass cleaner for mirror. Wipe frame with soft dry cloth. Hanging hardware included.
